source.binding_note: candidate_head names the parent of the commit that carries this artifact; an artifact cannot contain its own hash. scripts/check_capability_evidence_binding.mjs enforces this on every run.

change_scope: request/response boundary limits, numeric validation, gateway audit durability, and API contract consistency across the machine gateway, the ProjectOS bridge, and the Next.js boundary. No schema change, no deployment, no production data mutation.

defects_closed.boundary: size limits trusted only the declared Content-Length
defects_closed.detail: Number(header || "0") yields 0 for a missing header, so chunked, unlabelled, and understated requests reached JSON parsing with no limit

defects_closed.boundary: public /api/mcp proxy was unbounded in both directions
defects_closed.detail: request read with text() and upstream reply with arrayBuffer(), neither bounded, with no timeout
Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_LIMIT, Number(args.limit || 10))) is NaN for non-numeric input and reached the downstream query

defects_closed.boundary: gateway audit inserts discarded the returned Supabase error
defects_closed.detail: a failed audit write was indistinguishable from a successful one

audit_durability.allow_decision: fail closed when audit is not durable
audit_durability.deny_decision: never blocked on audit success, so an audit outage cannot weaken authorization

contract_consistency.previous_inconsistency: stored candidate metadata said metadata_only_v2_fail_closed while the API response said metadata_only_v1
contract_consistency.dependency_pin: bridge floating jsr:@supabase/supabase-js@2 pinned to npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2.110.9

test_evidence.limitation: Deno suites were not run in the authoring environment (Deno unavailable); they are proven by CI only. No load or adversarial testing was performed against a running service.

behavior_changes_requiring_review: Memory search now rejects unknown top-level fields instead of silently dropping them
out-of-range limit is rejected rather than clamped
evidence intake response now reports metadata_only_v2_fail_closed

activation_state.deployed_provider_versions: pandora-machine-gateway v3 and pandora-projectos-bridge v13, neither of which contains these changes

remaining_gates: independent review of this exact candidate head
merge into canonical main with the exact-merge-result gates green
separate production deployment authorization and rollback rehearsal

second_review_findings_closed: durable evidence binding was stale: candidate_head, candidate_tree, and canonical_base predated the second-author commits and the governance reconciliation. Refreshing only the pull-request body did not repair it.
the approved-canon contract leaked internal hard_canon/soft_canon labels because the response normalizer spread canonical_records through unchanged.
review_remediation.binding_guard: scripts/check_capability_evidence_binding.mjs, wired into npm run verify, fails when this lane's candidate_head is not the current head or its parent, when canonical_base is not the merge-base with the default branch, or when a recorded historical commit does not exist. 13 self-tests.
review_remediation.canon_label_fix: canonical_records are rebuilt rather than spread; canon-label fields are rewritten to the stable approved alias at any depth, keyed on field name so free text discussing canon status is never corrupted.
